title: MCP servers + Claude Code plugins inventory — 14 high-leverage external integrations PRISM does not yet wire
derived_from: user directive 2026-05-24: 'look for other mcp servers and plugins that would improve our systems'

units.title: GitHub MCP server — first-class repo introspection beyond gh CLI
units.description: PRISM uses `gh` CLI today (RTK-wrapped). Anthropic GitHub MCP gives structured (issue, PR, commit, review, search) tools with Zod-typed responses — composable from any dispatcher. Wire as MCP entry in C:/Users/wompu/.claude/settings.json + map to a thin `prism_github` dispatcher action set for in-engine use. R12 fail-soft: gh CLI fallback.
units.exit_criteria: MCP config entry + 6 dispatcher actions + 1 round-trip test + falls-back-to-gh-cli on outage

units.title: Postgres MCP server — LLM-direct query over PRISM prod data (jobs/customers/capacity)
units.description: PRISM has `mcp-server/src/db/` with PostgreSQL schema but no LLM-facing query MCP. Anthropic Postgres MCP exposes (list_tables, describe_table, query) with read-only credentials. Wire with a customer-data-safe role (no PII column access, no writes). Critical for PrismApp customer-bound chats needing live data.
units.exit_criteria: MCP config + RO role + safety allowlist + 3 query tests + audit-log integration
units.estimated_loc: ~120 LOC config + ~100 LOC safety + ~80 LOC tests

units.title: Sequential Thinking MCP — structured chain-of-thought for plan tracker + debate + self-correct
units.description: Anthropic Sequential Thinking MCP gives explicit `think` / `revise` / `branch` / `summarize` tools. Higher-leverage than free-form CoT for U-HCAP04 (self-correction), U-HCAP06 (plan tracker), U-HCAP12 (council debate). Wire as MCP + integrate into the 3 engines via injected `reasoner` opts.
units.exit_criteria: MCP config + reasoner-port abstraction in 3 engines + 4 integration tests
units.estimated_loc: ~80 LOC abstraction + ~150 LOC integration + ~100 LOC tests

units.title: Anthropic Memory MCP — comparison baseline vs PSN memory layer (run side-by-side)
units.description: Anthropic's reference Memory MCP is a single-namespace key-value layer. Wire it BESIDE PSN (not as a replacement) so U-HCAP05 eval-harness can benchmark recall@K + cost-per-correct vs PSN's 5-namespace multi-leg memory. Produces hard numbers for the 'PRISM exceeds Hermes memory' claim.
units.exit_criteria: MCP config + benchmark harness slot in U-HCAP05 + 1 weekly comparison report

units.title: Stripe MCP — payment/billing layer for PrismApp customer rollout
units.description: PrismApp will need subscription + per-customer usage billing (paired with U-HCAP03 cost telemetry). Anthropic Stripe MCP exposes (create_customer, list_subscriptions, create_invoice, etc). Wire with TEST-MODE credentials initially; prod gated behind operator approval. Critical path for PrismApp commercial launch.
units.exit_criteria: MCP config + test-mode wiring + 4 round-trip tests + operator-approval gate for prod creds

units.title: Slack MCP — bridge PRISM chat-bus to operator's actual Slack workspace
units.description: PRISM chat-bus today is JSONL on disk. Slack MCP lets the fleet POST alerts/handoffs/critical-block notices to a real Slack channel operators monitor. Pair with chat-bus emit hooks. Channel-allowlist to prevent fleet-noise spam.
units.exit_criteria: MCP config + chat-bus->Slack bridge + per-event allowlist + spam-throttle

units.title: Twilio MCP — shop-floor SMS alerts (machine down, job ready, quality fail)
units.description: Manufacturing shops live on phones, not Slack. Twilio MCP exposes (send_sms, make_call). Wire to U-HCAP08 quote-write + JobLifecycle + QualityGate engines for shop-floor-class alerts. Operator-allowlist of phone numbers per shop. Cost-bounded per-day per-shop.
units.exit_criteria: MCP config + 3 alert hook integrations + per-shop allowlist + daily cost cap

units.title: Smithery.ai MCP marketplace — browse/install community MCPs from inside PRISM
units.description: Smithery.ai is the de-facto community MCP registry (2026-04+). Build `prism_mcp_marketplace` dispatcher that searches Smithery, surfaces top-K with description/auth-requirement/license, and gates installation behind operator approval. Symmetric to U-HCAP16 (agentskills.io recipes) but for MCPs.
units.exit_criteria: dispatcher + 4 actions + operator-approval gate + 3 search tests

units.title: SendGrid MCP — quote-pack + customer-comm auto-send
units.description: Sister to U-HMPI07 (Twilio for SMS). SendGrid MCP for email — wire to U-HCAP08 quote.xlsx output so the QuoteToShip pipeline auto-emails customer-facing PDFs/XLSX. Per-customer allowlist + template-driven.
units.exit_criteria: MCP config + integration with QuoteToShip + per-customer allowlist + 3 send tests

units.title: Sentry MCP — APM + error tracking beyond local error-pattern-promote
units.description: PRISM has error-pattern-promote Stop hook but no real APM. Sentry MCP for production PrismApp deployments — captures (exception, breadcrumb, performance). Operator-gated to prevent PII leak; only PrismApp-tier exceptions; never PSN internal traces.
units.exit_criteria: MCP config + PrismApp-tier-only filter + PII scrubber + 4 capture tests

units.title: Notion MCP — customer-facing doc export from wiki + memory
units.description: Wiki + memory namespace are PRISM-internal. Notion MCP for customer-facing knowledge-base — push curated wiki entries (frontmatter `customer_visible:true`) to a customer's Notion workspace. Operator-curated; per-entry export gate.
units.exit_criteria: MCP config + per-entry export gate + 3 round-trip tests

units.title: superpowers plugin suite adoption — brainstorming + writing-plans + TDD
units.description: Anthropic superpowers plugin (already installed, see Skill tool list) ships {brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, test-driven-development, code-reviewer, systematic-debugging, requesting-code-review, subagent-driven-development, finishing-a-development-branch, dispatching-parallel-agents}. Audit which overlap with PRISM doctrine vs which are net-additive. Document adoption matrix + flag conflicts with existing PRISM hooks.
units.exit_criteria: adoption matrix doc (10 superpowers × PRISM doctrine) + conflict resolution per skill

units.title: hookify plugin — interactive hook authoring + lint
units.description: hookify plugin (already installed) ships {configure, hookify, list, writing-rules, conversation-analyzer}. PRISM has ~500 hooks; hookify's interactive authoring could replace hand-rolled new-hook scaffolds. Audit applicability vs existing /forge-hooks skill; document substitution policy.
units.exit_criteria: adoption decision doc + 1 sample hook authored via hookify + comparison vs /forge-hooks

units.title: Computer Use (Anthropic) — bridge to Excel/CAM/PLC GUIs PRISM can't reach via MCP
units.description: Anthropic Computer Use API (screenshot + click + type) reaches GUIs that have no MCP/CLI. Critical for legacy shop-floor apps (Master Post UI, CIMCO, certain CAM products without API). Wire as fallback path AFTER MCP/CLI/Office.js exhausted. Per-app allowlist + recorded session traces.
units.exit_criteria: Computer-Use wrapper + per-app allowlist + 1 demo session (Master Post automation) + audit-log

advisory: All 14 units are MCP/plugin INTEGRATION wires — they bring external code into the PRISM trust boundary. Every unit is operator-reviewable + operator-gated promote. Credentials (Stripe/Twilio/SendGrid/Postgres) staged TEST-MODE first; prod requires explicit operator approval. PII allowlists + cost caps + per-app allowlists baked into every integration. No-public-H: doctrine respected — internal-only deployment.
